content: Deliberate-practice sources (Bulletproof Musician/Noa Kageyama, Modacity blog, Piano Practice Assistant) converge on: spaced repetition within a session (return to a task after a short interval rather than blocked massed repetition), the 24-48-72-hour spacing rule across days for retention, two focused ~20-min sessions/day to avoid fatigue, and active self-supervision (listening critically, recording yourself) rather than passive repetition.
